body: // SOI/EOI anchor the entry rule. Without them a program that opens with a
// blank line or a comment will not parse.
Grammar skeleton.description: A complete grammar skeleton, anchored and with an atom rule.

Rule with alternatives.description: A rule with two labelled alternatives.

Atomic token.description: An atomic token: no inner nodes, no whitespace skipping.

Reserved words.description: Boundary-guard keywords and reject them as identifiers.

Contextual keywords.description: Boundary-guard without reserving — a word that is also a valid name.

Precedence table.description: An operator table written from scratch.

Precedence override.description: Adjust a preset rather than replacing it.

Error recovery.description: Resynchronise so one bad statement does not hide the rest.

Expected-token message.description: Replace a rule-name parse error with a sentence.

Lazy binding.description: Hand the handler the node instead of the evaluated value.
